articles.title: Rain98 is a blue-hued, pre-Y2K, Serial Experiments Lain inspired visual novel about time travelling to the past to end the world
articles.summary: Picture this. You're me, and you boot up the demo for Rain98, an incredibly blue-looking, rainy visual novel set in Tokyo, 1998, about a woman who refers to herself as the Angolmois, a world-ending reference to the predictions of good ole Nostradamus. At one point you have to light this woman's cigarette in a lightly stylish sequence. You get to a bit where you're asked to put your name in, and you put it in because like its predecessors, this is surely a self-insert kind of situation. Only you get a Steam achievement for getting a game over for putting your name in. Rude! But curious, so you, and of course I mean I, pressed on. Read more
articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke

articles.title: Black & White 3 doesn't sound like it's ever going to happen, but good ole overpromising Peter Molyneux may have let slip about a remaster of the original
articles.summary: Peter Molyneux feels like a man who can never die. He's just sort of always been there, and seems like he always will be, making some kind of game where you can hypothetically do what you want, never quite living up to expectations. But hey, he's Peter Molyneux, what else would you expect? The complicated icon is still ticking away at his latest, Masters of Albion , but in a recent interview, he spoke of one of his old classics, Black & White , and the idea of a third entry in the series (and the fact that there might be something newish on the way). articles.summary: I've taken a habit, recently, to proclaim my desire to explode in lieu of anything more realistically violent I could wish upon myself when I feel stressed. And, in what would likely be more concerning if I were a sentient bomb talking to a bomb diffusal squad, I've been saying that a lot lately, primarily because of the copious amounts of AI nonsense I've been seeing… everywhere. Epic Games , the ever-boycottable company called Microsoft , the decompiling community , the poison has found its way into everyone's veins and it's making me want to, say it with me now, explode! articles.title: 128 ГБ — уже мало? Сколько памяти нужно смартфону (Гайд)
articles.summary: В первом Android-смартфоне — HTC Dream — было всего 192 МБ оперативной памяти, а в iPhone — 128 МБ. Прошло много лет, и сегодня у многих наших телефонов оперативки иногда больше, чем в компьютерах. Производители в последние годы активно соревновались в том, у кого она объемнее и быстрее, теперь новой переменной стал рост цен на память. Правда, он влияет на конечную стоимость девайсов, но не на потребности. Так насколько оправданна гонка за гигабайтами? Сегодня поговорим обо всем, что касается памяти вашего смартфона. Читать далее…

articles.title: Seolhwa Dungeon turns Korean folktales into deadly roguelike rules
articles.summary: Beetlejuice is summoned only when you take his name three times. Jeoseung Saja, the grim reaper in Seolhwa Dungeon, works the other way round. He calls your name once for every turn he can see you, and on the third call, you’re the one who disappears. That’s a fair taste of how Seolhwa Dungeon, a turn-based roguelike RPG, goes about things.
